name: Thumbnail Agent
description: Internal thumbnail generator with brand-specific templates and fonts, script-based background generation, optional original-photo composition that keeps uploaded people unchanged, and PNG download.
person_reference_notes: The background is generated from the script, then a checked local cutout using original photo colors and detail is composited into the thumbnail.
Automatic cutouts require an OpenAI coverage check of the source photo and candidate mask for all people, faces, heads, hair, and bodies. The check evaluates coverage and does not identify people.
Uncertain isolation or coverage falls back to the intact original photo, including its background, with an explicit completion notice. Transparent PNG cutouts retain their supplied transparency.
Faces, hair, expressions, pose, and clothing are not generated again; only proportional scaling and positioning are applied to fit the brand.
Script and extra-prompt requests change the background, not the uploaded people's appearance.
Use the existing server OpenAI API key for planning and background generation; no separate reference-edit model setting is needed.
Install requirements.txt and keep bundled assets/u2netp.onnx for local masking. The existing OpenAI key is used for coverage checks and visual planning.
Review complete people, hair, and placement; a supplied transparent PNG gives direct control of the cutout.
security_notes: Do not share your personal OpenAI API key.
Each copied app should use its own OpenAI API key or a separate company-managed key.
Anyone with access to the hosted link can use the app unless they add their own access control.
usage_notes: Leverage Edu uses three headline lines, with the last highlighted turquoise; use MY JOURNEY TO | UNIVERSITY OF | SALFORD to choose the line breaks.
Optionally upload a photo to keep its original people, faces, hair, expressions, and clothing unchanged in a new background.
Review all people, hair, and placement when a person photo was supplied; the completion message explains any intact-photo fallback.
